_note: Task id -> class, for bench-results --by-class and bench-capabilities (reports/2026-09-24-local-vs-cloud-routing/design.md §4.1). Kept out of bench/tasks.json on purpose: bench-cheap-ops hashes tasks.json into harness_sha, so adding a key there would start a new harness generation and orphan every run so far, although a label changes nothing a run measures. Ids are shared across targets (M1 is the rename on Ktor, frontend and Spring alike), so one map covers bench/tasks.json and bench/targets/*.json. Whether a class is silent or caught is a property of the class and lives in bench-capabilities, not here.
